notes.title: 0.8 - Hordes & Gunsmoke
notes.notes:
Welcome back players! ShotSurged is back in action & going global with 0.8! The hordes & gunsmoke update!

Let’s cover everything huge added!

[h2]The Public Release![/h2]

For over 3 months ShotSurged has been in closed beta testing for a select few, these people have made alot of great memories and impact on ShotSurged. I want to thank all the beta testers for not only contributing to the future of ShotSurged, but also helping out tremendously with bug finding. Now it’s time for the whole world to play and enjoy ShotSurged.

[h2]Zombies[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301493/aca792e30690ae1d6e9e6cf833f7f62299c35610.png[/img]

0.8 brings a new classic & fun mode to the game, zombies! This mode is fairly straight forward and might seem very familiar to other classic horde survival games.

You jump in with just your pistol and your knife, kill some zombies to rack up enough points to hit the box, featuring every weapon from the multiplayer. Don’t got enough points? Don’t worry, buy a wall weapon! With every round brings more zombies which get faster, and stronger.

And if you need some extra fire power, look no further than bringing a friend or two. Zombies allows you to play with up to *8 players!*

Note:This mode will be launching in beta and will be updated regularly

[h2]Multiplayer: 3 Brand New Modes[/h2]

Aside from zombies being one of the new bigger modes, the multiplayer side of ShotSurged delivers 3 brand new modes.

[i]Gun Game[/i]

Each kill grants you a new weapon.

[i]Kill Confirmed[/i]

Collect enemy tags and deny friendly tags from being captured.

[i]Domination[/i]

Capture and hold points all across the map.


[h2]Emotes![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301493/d5ea67048c763d62efacb95ee2d81e1bf4815173.gif[/img]

Sometimes you’ve just got to show off your flair in a way that isn’t an operator or calling card, so bust a move!

Starting with the new update, be sure to hit the shop to pickup some emotes and show your opponents your moves. Below is a breakdown on how much certain emotes will cost:

[list]
[*] Emote (Eg:Dancing) - 500
[*] Gesture (Eg:Saluting) - 200
[/list]

This update brings 5 new emotes, all available in the shop.


[h2]Bot support for most modes![/h2]

In some cases maybe there aren’t alot of players playing ShotSurged, as an indie FPS it may be troubling sometimes to get a strong playerbase time to time. But no worries, with 0.8 bots can now play almost every game mode. Gone are the days of playing just TDM and FFA with bots, now you can play just about any mode with them! (Yes.. they do play for the objective xD)

[h2]Tac Sprinting[/h2]

Some scenarios might have you pinned down, wanna stab out of the battlefield without lettin' em hit ya? Use tactical sprinting to your advantage. Be careful though, it's not infinite!

Thanks for riding with us on this journey, enjoy the update! (Full patch notes below!)


[i]Update notes for ShotSurged 0.8.0:[/i]

[h3]New[/h3]

[list]
[*] The public release! ShotSurged is now available to EVERYBODY!
[*] New main menu UI
[*] New CO-OP Mode | Zombies
[*] New Cosmetic Type | Emotes
[*] New map | Containturned (Zombies Only)
[*] Added a new operator | Aura Swat
[*] Added 6 new calling cards
[*] Added 3 new modes(Gun Game, Kill Confirmed, Domination)
[*] Added support for bots in all game modes [Alpha & Experimental!]
[*] Added tactical sprinting
[*] Added subtitles
[*] Added the ability to zoom in on all snipers
[*] Added vaulting animations visible to other players
[*] Added options for creating & signing in with discord and google
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed faulty hitboxes on bots & players
[*] Fixed an issue where the V11 scope & the sniper scopes were very off centered, causing them to also be very inaccurate
[*] Fixed an issue where diving threw you on the ground instead of launching you forward
[*] Fixed an issue where all operators would use the same lines for throwing frags
[*] Fixed an issue where crawling in prone was the same speed as crouching
[*] Fixed an issue where team scores weren’t counting when you killed a bot
[*] Fixed an issue where the old protection effect would make your weapon seethrough and also mess with the muzzle flash
[*] Fixed an issue where outlines weren’t working on players
[*] Fixed an issue where the frontline wasn’t playing a reload sound
[*] Fixed an issue where players using the M4A1 would have spectators clip into their bodies
[*] Fixed an issue where you could not use/equip calling cards
[*] Fixed an issue where emblems were very zoomed in
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks[/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed bot and player models
[*] Changed the footstep sounds
[*] Changed the exodus spawn theme
[*] Made all gun fire anims look more appealing
[*] Improved the protection effect on players and bots
[*] Updated the lines on Ringer, Ace, and Cobra
[*] Removed the damage number indicator
[*] Improved the login UI
[*] Added more helpful tips to the loading screen
[*] Updated the ace, ringer, and infamy calling cards
[*] Updated the ace and ringer emblems
[*] Brought back the old kill notif
[*] Updated the map icons for Containment and Underway
[/list]

[h3]Guns:[/h3]

[ Buffs ]

[list]
[*] Increased the time to reload on the K10 CQB
[*] Increased the damage on the Calisto-47
[*] Increased the fire rate on the Calisto-47
[*] Increased the damage on the G18
[/list]

[ Nerfs ]

[list]
[*] Decreased the Bulldogs fire rate
[*] Decreased the fire rate on the Deadbolt 5.56
[/list]

[h3]Known issues:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The harbringer 410s scope is a little off centered
[*] Vaulting animations do not play
[*] Discord login may not work
[/list]

notes.title: 0.7.2 Insight - The Shop!
notes.notes:
Hi players,

As we draw closer to 0.7.2, I would like to tell you all of a brand new feature coming to 0.7! It's called The Shop. Let's take a deep dive into what it is and how it works:

[h3][b]THE SHOP[/b][/h3]

The shop is a brand new way for you to be rewarded just by playing the game! On top of now leveling up to earn weapons you will now be granted a certain amount of XP tokens that can be used to purchase all kinds of things from the shop! Ranging from operators, weapons, emblems, calling cards, and more!

[h3][b]EARNING XP TOKENS[/b][/h3]

Earning XP tokens is as simple as [u]playing the game![/u] There are no strings attached, we estimate that you will earn around 100 XPT per game or more.

[h3][b]PRICING[/b][/h3]

You will find that certain items in the shop may be priced higher or lower than other items, we've come up with a simple way to price items that is explained below:

[i][u]OPERATORS - 500
WEAPONS - 350
EMBLEMS - 150
CALLING CARDS - 200[/u][/i]

Once the update for 0.7 goes live there will be a whopping total of [i]17[/i] items available in the shop! The shop will be updated regularly so be sure to stack up those XP tokens!
